zoe_acct: Heads-up: Rivet's private deployment renewal invoice (inv#1003201) hit AP and they flagged a "true-up" mismatch. They expected a one-time credit for unused reserved concurrency after decomm on 2026-04-12. Invoice shows no credit.
omar_billing: Pulling invoice. System shows PLATFORM_FEE = $63,000 period 2026-04-01 -> 2026-06-30. Contracted reserved concurrency reduced Apr 12, effective same day per amendment 2026-03C.
sam_contracts: Confirmed I uploaded amendment 2026-03C on Mar 22. Clause 4.1 specifies mid-billing-window true-up by pro-rata daily calculation.
zoe_acct: Customer's expected math: April charged full month at old rate then credit for 18 days at new lower rate; net credit ~= $14,400. They sent a spreadsheet.
billing-bot: invoice-generator: created inv 1003201 at 1771001200. amendment_sync shows amendment attached but status=APPLIED=false for this billing run. Error: "billing-window-boundary not supported for daily-proration".
omar_billing: Looks like similar ingestion bug as last month. I'll try targeted regen for this customer. If regen can't be completed today we should issue CM and corrected invoice.
legal_ops: Prefer corrected invoice + credit memo for audit trail. If we must issue credit first, include amendment id and a short justification note referencing SOW.
sam_contracts: One more wrinkle: Rivet also downgraded support tier on 2026-04-20 (ticket #4457). That reduces recurring support fee; invoice still shows old tier for whole quarter. Two problems in same invoice.
o_mar_billing: Opening a billing ops task. Plan: 1) attempt `billing-service --regen --cust=rivet --inv=1003201` now, 2) if regen fails, issue credit memo for combined overcharge (~$18,200) and follow with regenerated invoice. Also will run audit query for other private customers with amendments in Apr/May.
zoe_acct: Please cc procurement@rivet.io and acctmgr@redwood on any customer communications. Customer asked for resolution before EOD tomorrow.
omar_billing: Regen attempt in progress.
billing-bot: regen result: FAILED at 1771002400 due to transient dependency on pricing-service cache.
omar_billing: Cache team notified; in parallel I'll draft CM-1003201-1 for the $18,200 and include GL reversal codes. Posting draft here for review.
legal_ops: Draft looks good. Add line: "Credit issued per amendment 2026-03C and support tier change per ticket 4457; see SOW section 4.1 for proration."
zoe_acct: Sending the draft to Rivet's AP for pre-approval now, to avoid PO hold escalation. Thanks team.
billing-bot: Follow-up: pricing-service cache warmed and pending one-off regen. Will re-run regen job tonight for any affected private accounts.
omar_billing: Will post final invoice id and credit memo number when complete.
